description: AGSC-09-19 (the declaration) with AGSC-11-16: a node whose tool server speaks both revisions declares ONE value as the `agsc-surface-version` of its `mcp` surface, the newest revision the transport speaks, `2026-07-28`. The node serves the tool server to others (`mcp_served`), so its discovery document carries the `rel#surface` link of `mcp`; the link's `agsc-surface-version` is `["2026-07-28"]`, and it equals the first element of `supportedVersions` that the stdio server returns for `server/discover` (`declared_equals_newest_supported`). A server that speaks `2025-11-25` only declares that revision (AGSC-11-16; `bnd-0037` states the echo), which is not this case. The protocol-version constant of the distribution is the same value (`protocol_version_constant`).
